title: AI Browser Game Jam #2 just wrapped! 47 games submitted, 104 people joined
author: Slackluster
selftext:
AI Browser Game Jam #2 just wrapped up — 47 games submitted, 104 people joined

First jam had 50 people and 29 entries so we basically doubled it. Theme was Alien. All 47 games are free and playable in browser right now, voting is open for 7 days.

I started this jam because most game jams don't welcome AI and the few that do are usually tied to a specific sponsor. This one is completely open, use whatever you want. No drama, just make games and share what you learned.

A real community is starting to form around this. People sharing workflows, leaving feedback, helping each other in the Discord. I play every game and leave feedback myself. We're already planning the next jam.

If you've been making AI games on your own and want a reason to finish something and get real feedback, come hang out.

Play the games: [https://itch.io/jam/ai-game-jam-2/entries](https://itch.io/jam/ai-game-jam-2/entries)

Discord: [https://discord.gg/86xBnZqHjy](https://discord.gg/86xBnZqHjy)

comments.author: moneydollarz
comments.body: Please make more jams in the future this was such a cool way to showcase other people’s games with the ai tools
